---
title: "Examples"
---

Scripts from the `examples/` folder, each ending with its figures. Run one
from the repository root with `uv run python examples/<name>.py`.

Energy balance:

- [Wind input power](wind_power.qmd): the EPRI experimental curves, their
  fits, and the OLLA and Foti models.
- [Damping power](damping_power.qmd): the self-damping power of every method
  against amplitude, frequency and tension.
- [Amplitude for every pair of methods](ymax_methods.qmd): the antinode
  amplitude against frequency for each wind and damping method.
- [Comparing damping methods](ymax_damping_comparison.qmd): amplitudes on
  random cases and the rank correlation between damping methods.

Fatigue damage:

- [Bending amplitude near the clamp](bending_amplitude.qmd): the CIGRE and
  Poffenberger-Swart amplitudes behind the fictive stress.
- [Fictive stress](fictive_stress.qmd): the three methods against the
  antinode amplitude.
- [Safe border line](safe_border_line.qmd): the single and multi-layer
  curves against the EPRI fatigue tests, and their inverse.
- [Quantile regression](qreg.qmd): predicted against measured cycles to
  failure.

Lifespan:

- [Yearly damage against wind speed](damage_year.qmd): amplitude, stress,
  strain and damage for each fictive stress method.
- [Weibull damage of many conductors](damage_weibull_array.qmd): the scalar
  and array versions, and the lifespan against the tension.

Stockbridge dampers (experimental):

- [Impedance](stockbridge_impedance.qmd): modulus and phase of a damper
  impedance.
- [Dissipated power](stockbridge_power.qmd): the power against the damper
  position (work in progress).
